name: multiply
description: Multiplies two numbers and produces a result. The numbers must have type float or int and the result will be float or int type.
syntax_line: multiply {multiplicand} from {multiplier} and store result in {multiplicationResult}

id_1.description: Multiplicand must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as multiplicand

id_2.description: Multiplier must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as multiplier
